This page shows every active MLS® listing for homes in Sardis, BC. Here is how the local sub-areas compare.
Sardis East Vedder
Sardis East Vedder: established family streets east of Vedder Road close to shops, parks and Sardis Secondary.
Sardis West Vedder
Sardis West Vedder: quiet cul-de-sacs and gated adult complexes west of Vedder Road near the Vedder River trails.
Sardis South
Sardis South: newer subdivisions and townhome sites toward the Vedder River and Cultus Lake Road.
Garrison Crossing
Garrison Crossing: the former CFB Chilliwack base, now a walkable village of heritage-style homes, townhomes and condos.
Promontory
Promontory: hillside view homes and newer townhome complexes above Sardis, mostly built 1995–2020.
Vedder Crossing
Vedder Crossing: the commercial heart of the south side, with condos and townhomes close to the Vedder River.

A strata-titled home brings the BC Strata Property Act into play. Get the Form B, the bylaws on pets, rentals and age restrictions, the depreciation report and two years of recent strata minutes ahead of removing subjects. Complexes aimed at 55+ and 45+ enforce age bylaws, which at least one occupant has to satisfy.

Portions of Rosedale, Fairfield Island, lower Sardis, Greendale and Yarrow lie inside the floodplain along the Fraser and Vedder Rivers, and protection comes from the City's dike network. Find out what the lender and insurer will want, along with the property's flood construction level, and whether title has a registered covenant, geotechnical or floodplain.

For schools, Chilliwack is part of School District 33 (SD33), where G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary sits among its schools together with Sardis Secondary and Chilliwack Secondary, and elementary catchments include Watson, Vedder and Unsworth. I would confirm the catchment with SD33 first. For transit, BC Transit covers Chilliwack, and Young Road, Luckakuck Way and Vedder Road all have service. Another option is Route 66: the Fraser Valley Express serves Chilliwack, Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

Where are homes for sale in Sardis usually located?

Garrison Crossing, Promontory, Vedder Crossing, Sardis South, Sardis East Vedder and Sardis West Vedder are where most Sardis homes are listed. Age, lot size and price vary by area, so before booking showings I suggest narrowing it down to two or three neighbourhoods.
How often do these Sardis home listings update?
Sold statuses, price changes and fresh listings appear quickly because this page gets updated from MLS® data supplied by Fraser Valley Real Estate Board a few times daily.
What should I check on zoning, strata or ALR before buying a Sardis home?

The BC Strata Property Act covers strata-titled homes like these. Prior to removing subjects, get the Form B together with the depreciation report, two years of the latest strata minutes and the bylaws, especially the parts on age restrictions, pets and rentals. If a complex is 55+ or 45+, its age bylaws are enforced, and at least one occupant is subject to them.
Are any Sardis homes in the floodplain?

Greendale, Yarrow, Rosedale, Fairfield Island and the lower end of Sardis all include floodplain land along the Fraser and Vedder Rivers, which the City's dike network protects. When you view a property, ask for its flood construction level, the lender and insurer requirements, plus whether title shows a geotechnical or floodplain covenant.
Which schools serve Sardis homes?

SD33 is the Chilliwack school district. Homes in Sardis and the south side are zoned toward Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham, whereas the north side draws on Chilliwack Secondary. Catchment lines can shift, so contact SD33 about the address you are considering.
Is public transit available near Sardis homes?

Yes. Local routes run by BC Transit in Chilliwack use Young Road, Vedder Road and Luckakuck Way, while the Fraser Valley Express heads out toward Abbotsford and Langley. Little or no bus service reaches the rural areas of Columbia Valley, Greendale and Ryder Lake.
